source_fact_dispositions.fact: Eight members include spontaneous hemiacetal cyclization, enol interconversion, and terminal oxaloacetate decarboxylation.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Retain complete boundary; GO0019617 partial boundary cannot substitute.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Structured enol E,E species and narrative-linked Z,Z species are chemically distinct; the narrative enzymes were characterized in gallate metabolism.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Unresolved transfer of exact enzyme substrate specificity into P184. Compare original figures and modern LigU/LigJ chemistry before assigning catalysis.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Native comments support NAD and NADP usage for the dehydrogenases, while selected equation consumes NADP.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Alternative coenzyme must be retained if protein included; the graph must not assert NADP exclusivity.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Hydratase sources differ by species and preparation; source comments include reversibility, thiol sensitivity, and a distinct metal-dependent GalB enzyme.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: No shared unqualified hydratase/metal claim; check historical substrate assignments and recombinant constructs separately.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Aldolase models describe alternate HMG substrate activity, chiral preference, assembly and divalent-metal effects; some also catalyze OAA decarboxylation.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Separate exact substrate/stereo and organism provenance; native broad CHA is stereochemically unspecified and cannot establish a specific S configuration.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Comamonas PmdE activity evidence is computational homology, not a direct enzyme assay.
Native comments only suggest extension of gallate tautomerase function to Sphingomonas homologs.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Inference does not establish exact pathway catalysis; primary later LigU evidence requires accession/strain resolution.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Comamonas complex is represented with four copies of each subunit; SYK6 native components have no explicit coefficient.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Preserve separate physical models and experimental sources; no equal assembly/construct inference.

source_fact_dispositions.fact: Mn, Ni, and Co regulator objects omit a mode sign.
source_fact_dispositions.disposition: Retain unsigned source facts; not evidence for activation or inhibition.
This is database context, not a direct elementary substrate-transfer claim to every TCA activity.

unresolved_requirements: Exact original GalD/GalB enol stereochemistry and native narrative-versus-structured mismatch.
Modern LigU/LigJ intermediate identity, actual assayed accessions and strain identity; avoid inferring all enzymes as SYK6.
Full assay construct/state and exact current protein/native complex correspondence for any retained catalysis, cofactor, or perturbation edge.
Separate broad native unspecified CHA from measured S-CHA; do not transfer stereospecific primary claim onto unspecified identity.
not_claimed: No maintained record, authority snapshot, graph, or tests changed.
Acquisition and internal chemistry are not independent review.
No claim that this source or pathway landscape is exhausted.
